about.description: Silver perpetual market. The contract tracks the price of one troy ounce of silver. Users get linear exposure to silver price moves without owning bullion, vaulted metal, or redeemable claims on physical inventory, with pricing referencing an external spot silver feed. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
